title: Carry Lookahead Adder
statement: Build an 8-bit carry lookahead adder module that computes group generate and propagate signals to accelerate carry calculations. The adder must produce correct sum and carry-out values while using these faster carry terms. This design is used in higher-performance arithmetic units.
module_signature: module carry_lookahead_adder(input [7:0] a, input [7:0] b, input cin, output [7:0] sum, output cout);
behavior: Use carry lookahead logic to compute carries efficiently.
Purely combinational: outputs must settle after input changes.
Do not depend on initial register values, clocks, or delays.
All outputs must be driven to known 0/1 values for every input case.
constraints: Do not implement it as a simple ripple-carry adder.
hint: Compute generate/propagate bits to avoid sequential carry propagation.
